resources.string: Black out the screen; video keeps playing.
Needed to lay the black cover on top of YouTube or any other app.
Shows the Unlock and Black out buttons in your notification shade.
Tap, then go back to your video. Easiest of all: use the Black Screen tile in Quick Settings while the video is playing.
Go back to your video now
Could not start. Please try the Quick Settings tile.
Pull down Quick Settings, tap the pencil (edit), and drag in “Black Screen”.

• Start your video, pull down Quick Settings and tap Black Screen. Or tap Black out in the notification.
• The screen goes black and ignores touches. The video and sound keep going.
• To unlock: tap the same spot 4 times quickly. Or pull down the notification shade and tap Unlock (or the tile).
• Touch the screen once to see a faint reminder.
Turn the display fully off while the phone is in a pocket or face down. The video keeps playing.
Keeps a small silent notification so you can black out with one tap.

Volume and power buttons still work. On some phones, swipes from the very edge of the screen (Back, Home, notification shade) can still get through. The power button turns the screen off as usual, which may pause some videos.
Free forever · No ads · No login · No internet
Tap here 4 times quickly to unlock
Tap Black out to cover the screen. Your video keeps playing.
Tap the same spot 4 times quickly, or tap Unlock.
